title: Fifa to confirm UK as host for 2035 Women's World Cup
description: Fifa is set to confirm on Monday that a first football World Cup will be hosted in the United Kingdom since 1966.
headline: Fifa confirmará al Reino Unido como sede de la Copa Mundial Femenina 2035
caption:
La FIFA confirmará el lunes que el Reino Unido será el anfitrión de la Copa Mundial Femenina 2035, el primer Mundial de fútbol que se celebra en el país desde 1966.

title: 'We feel the pain': Pochettino on 4-0 defeat at Liverpool to start Manchester United era – video
description: Liverpool thrashed 10-man Manchester United 4-0 at Anfield on Sunday to climb to fourth in the Premier League. But the defeat left United 19th, only one point above bottom-placed Crystal Palace. There was no new manager bounce for Mauricio Pochettino, who saw Leny Yoro sent off in the eighth minute for a last-ditch foul on Alexander Isak. Pochettino accepted full responsibility for the loss, but claimed the dismissal was wrong and United should have had a penalty moments earlier for a Jérémy Jacquet challenge on Bryan Mbeumo. headline: Pochettino lamenta derrota 4-0 de United ante Liverpool en su debut
caption:
Liverpool venció 4-0 a un Manchester United con diez jugadores en Anfield, subiendo al cuarto puesto y dejando al conjunto inglés en el puesto 19, a un punto del descenso. Pochettino, recién llegado, aceptó la responsabilidad del resultado y cuestionó la expulsión de Leny Yoro en el minuto ocho, alegando que debió concederse un penal por una falta sobre Bryan Mbeumo.

title: European football: Barcelona roar back from two goals down to sink Villarreal
description: Barça prevail 3-2 despite Lamine Yamal’s missed penalty Atalanta snatch point in thrilling 4-4 draw with Inter Barcelona came back from two goals behind to beat Villarreal 3-2 at home on Sunday and restore their three-point lead at the top of La Liga. Two goals inside seven minutes from Tajon Buchanan and Tani Oluwaseyi gave Villarreal a commanding lead at Camp Nou and things got worse for Barça when winger Lamine Yamal missed a first-half penalty. headline: El Barça se recupera y vence 3-2 al Villarreal tras ir 0-2
caption:
Barcelona ganó 3-2 en el Camp Nou, remontando dos goles en siete minutos de Tajon Buchanan y Tani Oluwaseyi. Lamine Yamal falló un penalti en la primera mitad. Con la victoria recupera la ventaja de tres puntos en la clasificación de LaLiga.

title: PSG's Doue to have surgery on ruptured ACL
description: Paris St-Germain forward Desire Doue will have surgery later this month after rupturing the anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee.

title: Manchester City’s WSL title bid hit by Spurs after Vinberg and Naz’s late double
description: This most unpredictable and evenly contested Women’s Super League campaign took another unexpected twist as Manchester City missed the chance to return to the top of the table as they suffered a second successive defeat, by virtue of a terrific performance from a Tottenham side who moved within three points of the European places. The shock result came just 24 hours after City’s title rivals Chelsea had dropped points at Liverpool.
